entries.title: Earth observation embeddings are effective sub-grid descriptors for probabilistic weather downscaling

entries.note: This company Zeus AI is making AI/ML weather models, they came out with this cool new weather world model yesterday that takes in raw observational data and creates a constant state of the atmosphere based on how all those observational instruments would see it. Cool stuff I think! Their blog post:
entries.title: Introducing WeatherDreamer: A World Model for the Weather
